row.title: A checkout's stored token wins over the token in a push URL
row.body: actions/checkout stores GITHUB_TOKEN as an http extraheader for github.com, and a later git push to an x-access-token URL still sends that header, so GitHub reads the push as github-actions[bot]. Evidence: tenant-repos run 45669381614 held a one-repo token from the platform route (TENANT-REPO-2) and its push to base-rates answered 403. Fixed in the same change: the job sets persist-credentials false and records a failed push per repository, then goes on; the workflow lint passes and the next tenant-repos run is the live probe.
